intro: Tell apart verifiable data, the selection of information and persuasion resources. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Le dossier d'une entreprise qualifie son nouveau service de « révolutionnaire » et promet une livraison sans attente.
frases.alumno: The company's file describes its new service as «revolutionary» and promises delivery without any waiting.

frases.estudio: Il cite un délai moyen de douze minutes, sans préciser la période ni l'origine de la mesure.
frases.alumno: It cites an average time of twelve minutes, without specifying the period or where the measurement comes from.

frases.estudio: Une association indépendante relève, sur un échantillon plus large, des écarts importants selon l'heure et la zone.
frases.alumno: An independent association notes, in a larger sample, significant differences depending on the time and the area.

frases.estudio: Le premier texte cherche à séduire; le second explicite davantage la méthode, sans pour autant répondre à toutes les questions.
frases.alumno: The first text aims to appeal; the second explains the method better, although it does not answer every question either.

texto: Tell apart verifiable data, the selection of information and persuasion techniques. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: evaluative adjectives, rhetorical questions and data without a source steer the reading without proving a claim. In this passage, «entreprise» means «company».
